name: Rust
summary: Learn Rust expressions, ownership, borrowing, collections, and recoverable errors.

lessons.title: Bindings, functions, and expressions
lessons.explanation: Rust infers many types and lets you annotate them when useful. Bindings are immutable by default. A function can return the last expression of a block when that expression has no trailing semicolon.

api.name: let / let mut
api.description: Introduce an immutable or mutable binding.

api.name: println!(...)
api.description: Format a message and print a newline.

api.name: cargo run
api.description: Build and run the current Cargo package.

lessons.practice: Add a quantity parameter and a fixed discount. Predict the return type before checking it.
lessons.pitfall: A semicolon after the last expression changes the block value to ().

lessons.title: Ranges, iteration, and pattern matching
lessons.explanation: if can return a value when both branches agree on a type. for consumes values from an iterable. match compares against patterns and must handle every possibility.

api.name: start..end / start..=end
api.description: Build a range with an exclusive or inclusive end.

api.name: match value { ... }
api.description: Select an arm based on a pattern.

api.name: if let Some(x) = value
api.description: Run a block when an Option contains a value.

lessons.practice: Classify scores into three bands and add a label for the top band.
lessons.pitfall: An exclusive range stops before its endpoint. Check which endpoint semantics the task needs.

lessons.title: Ownership, borrowing, and slices
lessons.explanation: Each owned value has an owner and is cleaned up when that owner leaves scope. Passing an owned String by value usually moves it. Borrow it as &str when a function just needs to read the text.

api.name: String::from(text)
api.description: Create an owned UTF-8 string.

api.name: &T / &mut T
api.description: Borrow for shared access or exclusive mutable access.

api.name: str::split_whitespace()
api.description: Iterate over nonempty parts separated by whitespace.

lessons.practice: Write a function that returns the final word as a borrowed slice. Test with an empty string.
lessons.pitfall: You cannot mutate a value while a shared reference to it still needs to be used.

lessons.title: Vectors, maps, and iterator adapters
lessons.explanation: Vec grows as you add elements. HashMap associates a key with a value. An iterator can lazily transform elements until a consuming operation requests its output.

api.name: Vec::push(value)
api.description: Append an item.

api.name: Vec::get(index)
api.description: Return an optional reference, avoiding a panic on a bad index.

api.name: HashMap::entry(key).or_insert(value)
api.description: Access an entry and initialize it when missing.

api.name: Iterator::map() / filter() / collect()
api.description: Transform, filter, and gather values.

lessons.practice: Count only labels longer than two characters, then print the count for a missing name.
lessons.pitfall: Indexing with [] can panic. Use get for positions from untrusted input.

lessons.title: Structs, enums, and traits
lessons.explanation: A struct bundles named fields. An enum can hold data in different variants. A trait defines shared behavior and an impl block supplies the methods for a type.

api.name: impl Trait for Type
api.description: Provide a trait implementation for a type.

api.name: Option<T>
api.description: Express a value that may be absent.

api.name: Result<T, E>
api.description: Express success with T or failure with E.

lessons.practice: Add an InProgress variant with a percentage and update the match.
lessons.pitfall: Choose a variant with named fields when several values need clear roles.

lessons.title: Parsing, filesystem errors, and tests
lessons.explanation: Use Result for errors that callers may handle. In a compatible return type, ? returns early on an error. Paths and filesystem operations are available in std::path and std::fs.

api.name: str::parse::<T>()
api.description: Convert text to a type implementing FromStr.

api.name: std::fs::read_to_string(path)
api.description: Read an entire UTF-8 text file or return an I/O error.

api.name: std::path::Path::join(part)
api.description: Create a path with another component.

api.name: cargo test
api.description: Run tests in the current package.

lessons.practice: Check that invalid text returns Err, then use std::fs::read_to_string to supply a number from a small local file.
lessons.pitfall: Avoid unwrap on untrusted inputs. Use match, a fallback, or propagation instead.
